access_links.label: ILU metadata catalogue, dataset row DS10 (descriptive only)

access_note: The source catalogue states restricted access under NDA. It does not publish the agreement, an application procedure or permission to reuse the underlying observations.
description: The ILU metadata catalogue identifies Lisbon ILD data supplied by the Lisbon municipality, with Lisbon Council as geographic coverage and CSV as the format. The linked descriptions identify the transport monitoring observations as inductive-loop inputs. The catalogue records use in a Lisbon traffic-forecast comparison, emerging-pattern detection and congestion biclustering. These links establish the concrete modelling and analysis role of the collection; they do not establish identical samples across studies. Access is restricted under a non-disclosure agreement. Collection dates, detector inventory, temporal interval, precise measured fields and missing-data coverage are not specified in the catalogue row. The public metadata are separate from the confidential observations. No current measurement endpoint or access-request process has been verified, and licence terms and charges remain unknown.
